notes: All wheel artifacts target CPython 3.14 on x86_64 musl and are fetched before measurement.

The pyperformance 1.14.0 payload list is pinned with CPython 3.14/musllinux-compatible releases where older upstream requirement pins have no compatible wheel: coverage 7.16.1, dulwich 0.24.10, SQLAlchemy 2.0.43 with greenlet 3.5.6, MarkupSafe 3.0.3, PyYAML 6.0.3, and urllib3 2.5.0.
FastAPI 0.121.0 uses Pydantic 2.13.5 and pydantic-core 2.46.5; the CPython 3.14 pydantic-core wheel uses the compatible musllinux 1.1 x86_64 tag.
pyaes 1.6.1 is a pure-Python source archive because PyPI publishes no wheel; only its pyaes module directory is extracted into the external pyperformance prefix.
CPython 3.14 does not support the old pyperformance Django 3.2.4 benchmark on every workload. The separate repository-owned macros family uses Django 6.1.1.
